fields.name: userId
fields.description: IAM user id (OIDC sub) this note belongs to. Part of the composite primary key (userId + padType) — one row per (user, padType) pair. The read+write hooks filter by both to scope the row.

fields.name: padType
fields.description: Which notepad slot: 'text' | 'excel'. Replaces localStorage keys 'lattice.notepad.text.v1' and 'lattice.notepad.excel.v1'. Both requiredOn: 'Both' so it rides on every PATCH.

fields.name: rowsJson
fields.description: JSON-encoded Array<NotepadRow>. For 'text' mode this is typically a single row with the paragraph text; for 'excel' mode it's the cell grid. '[]' when the pad is empty.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: ISO timestamp of the last write. Audit only; not surfaced in the UI today.
